about.text: A cylindrical, pressed, semi-hard farm caciotta of cow's milk from the middle Val di Vara in Liguria, made year-round across the province of La Spezia. Raw milk is heated to about 39 °C, given rennet, the curd is cut to walnut size, moulded and dry-salted, then aged about a month, turned regularly.
